aid.title: Yale Undergraduate Financial Aid - Prospective Students

test_policy.notes: First-year and transfer applicants must include SAT or ACT scores (self-reporting allowed; official scores required on enrollment). ACT Science and Writing optional. Superscoring allowed.

requirements.notes: Yale-specific short answers for 2026-27 (two on academic interests plus three 200-character questions on Common/Coalition). School report with transcript required. Interviews are evaluative, by invitation only, and not required. Application fee amount not stated on the pages checked; fee waivers via Common App/Coalition.

deadlines.label: Single-Choice Early Action
deadlines.notes: Non-binding but restrictive. Decisions mid-December (no exact date published); reply by May 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions late March (no exact date published); reply by May 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of non-native speakers who have not completed at least two years of secondary education in an English-medium school.

english.notes: Most competitive applicants typically score at least 100 (tests taken before 2026-01-21). Not a hard minimum.
Most competitive applicants typically score 5 or higher (tests taken after 2026-01-21). Not a hard minimum.
Most competitive applicants typically have 7 or higher.
Most competitive applicants typically have at least 120.
C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency or B2 First; most competitive applicants typically have 185 or higher.

aid.notes: All applicants are evaluated without regard to ability to pay and Yale meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted students, including international. Indicate interest in aid on the application; the ISFAA is not accepted in place of Yale's own aid forms. No merit awards (need-based Yale Scholarship only).

tier_notes.business: No undergraduate business major (Economics is the usual route).
tier_notes.nursing: No undergraduate nursing (Yale nursing is graduate-only).
tier_notes.engineering: Engineering & Applied Science is small relative to Yale's arts and sciences.
tier_notes.biology_life_sci: Top-10 life sciences with a major medical school on campus.
tier_notes.pre_med: Strong pre-med outcomes and research access through Yale School of Medicine.
tier_notes.economics: Top-10 economics department; just outside the top-5 group.
tier_notes.humanities: Humanities (history, English, philosophy, classics) are among the very best in the US.
tier_notes.arts_design: Schools of Art, Music and Drama are among the best in the US; undergraduates can major in art, music and theater.
